# Hypothesis tests (machine-generated by `python -m pbi stats`; do not edit)

**INCOMPLETE: no scores for things_meg; their cells count as not confirmed.**

Cell = dataset x metric. Confirmed in a cell: one-sided permutation p < 0.05 after Holm correction across
the 9 cells AND 95% subsample CI excluding 0 (H6: upper CI < 1). CIs: 1000 subsamples of 80% of stimuli; permutation tests: 10000 permutations; shuffled-stimulus nulls: 1000 permutations.

## Verdicts (preregistered thresholds)

| Hypothesis | Verdict | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| H1 Trained > random-init | **FAIL** | confirmed in 3/9 cells (threshold >= 7/9) |
| H2 Alignment rises with capability (headline) | **FAIL** | confirmed datasets: mknn 0/3, CKA 0/3, RSA 0/3 (threshold: mknn >= 2 AND (CKA >= 2 OR RSA >= 2)); alternative reading counting a dataset if CKA or RSA is confirmed: 0/3 -> fail |
| H3 Alignment rises with scale within vision families | **FAIL** | mutual k-NN: mean within-family rho confirmed in 0/3 datasets (threshold >= 2/3); mean rho > 0 with CI excluding 0 (ignoring p): 0/3 |
| H4 Language-only models above chance | **FAIL** | (a) best language model above shuffled-stimulus null on fMRI-IT (mutual k-NN): yes (p=0.0010); (b) mean within-LM-family scale rho > 0 on fMRI-IT (mutual k-NN): no |
| H5 Model-model agreement predicts model-brain agreement | **PASS** | mutual k-NN: confirmed in 2/3 datasets (threshold >= 2/3) |
| H6 No model reaches the noise ceiling | **FAIL** | upper CI < 1 in 6/9 cells (threshold 9/9) |

**Headline decision rule:** H2 failed and H1/H5 did not both pass: no convergence claim; see cells below.
